label: About
title: About Pink Passes Through
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 8 recent saved-signal files and 6 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @manta_timing: images imagez and @lennyjpg: Malevich Black Square, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Pink Passes Through: Landscape digital character collage on dusty pink. An asymmetric chestnut crown and softly lit cheek overlook a fitted black bodice and gathered pale apron. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Bent bare arm and hand-at-waist gesture, Cracked black puff-sleeve surface, and Coral-edged white wrist pleats with yellow lining.

typography.body_family: 'DFE Newsreader', Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
